title: TabulariaDatasetFacet
description: A dataset facet Tabularia attaches to its own datasources: how to get from the catalog back to the object in Tabularia. The dataset is named after the folder path and the datasource name (`tabularia://<namespace>` + `/Folder/Subfolder/name`); the parquet it currently serves is in the `symlinks` facet and in `dataSource.uri`.

datasourceId.description: The id of the datasource in Tabularia: GET /datasources/{id}

projectId.description: The id of the folder (project) that holds it

kind.description: How the datasource is produced: by a flow, by a refresh from a database or SharePoint, by an upload

folder.description: The folder path, as shown in Tabularia (e.g. Sample/Flows)
